protocol.evaluation_role: fixed consumed historical evidence; no new untouched holdout or prospective confirmation
protocol.extra_preprocessing: append one numeric input; training median and StandardScaler, same M4 semantics; missing OOS rows excluded before preprocessing, never filled
protocol.fit: 2024-25 independently evidenced points labels only; all preprocessing and fit evidence strictly before first 2025-26 capture

join.missing: retain audit and null feature; exclude from both matched populations; no fallback
join.source: exact historical source/build identity and shared consumed table hashes

point_contract.as_of: accepted snapshot capture (not the later deadline)
point_contract.baseline_fit: only train labels settled by prediction capture; frozen for validation and test
point_contract.empty_sum: zero for a snapshot player without facts in a fixture-bearing GW
point_contract.external_benchmark: archived FPL ep_next, separate from features; missing remains missing
point_contract.fallback: recent mean3 or player season mean (minimum 3) -> train position mean -> train overall -> 0

points_count_3.definition: Number of available values in G-3..G-1

points_count_5.definition: Number of available values in G-5..G-1

points_mean_3.definition: Mean of available settled points in G-3..G-1

points_mean_5.definition: Mean of available settled points in G-5..G-1

previous_points.definition: Settled points in G-1, null if unavailable

season_points_count.definition: Number of available values in GWs 1..G-1

season_points_mean.definition: Mean of available settled points in GWs 1..G-1

point_contract.fixture_empty_gameweek: retain features and predictions; null label, excluded from fitting/scoring/history
point_contract.history: strictly earlier GW; points independently observed settled by capture; season-local
point_contract.history_no_facts: zero only when settled archive event_points explicitly equals zero; otherwise missing
point_contract.identity: season-local; never join on person code
point_contract.population: accepted snapshot position IDs 1..4, including non-playing registered players
point_contract.ranking: mean within-season/GW Spearman using average ties; constant groups undefined and counted
point_contract.target: sum of canonical fixture total_points in target GW; all fixtures in doubles
point_contract.target_type: nullable integer; unmultiplied player points, no captain/chip effects
point_contract.windows: previous 3/5 calendar GWs; mean of available values; counts explicit; no zero imputation

preprocessing.categorical_null: literal __missing__; does not imply any actual status
preprocessing.encoding: training one-hot, all categories retained; unknown all-zero
preprocessing.null_semantics: Computational fills only; original missingness indicators retain meaning. No null-as-fit interpretation.
preprocessing.numeric_imputation: training median; all-null column fallback 0 with indicator retained
preprocessing.scaling: training StandardScaler on imputed numeric columns; both families use same projection

protocol.ranking: per GW forecast top min(10,n), descending prediction then ascending element ID; mean realised points per selected player, then equal mean across GWs; only independently labelled common rows
protocol.references: frozen M4 hist_15 has different fitting population, not a feature ablation; original M3 baselines unchanged; ep_next remains reference only
protocol.segments: overall; each GW; position 1..4; established history count>=3, low history count<3; any original feature missing; chance missing
protocol.selection: none; xpts_v2 is the predefined candidate, control is only an ablation
protocol.serialization: pickle protocol 5 with memoization disabled for these acyclic local estimator states; object alias sharing is not model state; fail on cycles
